lines.1: 「I... I can't just let her make a fool of me!」
lines.2: Crab pulls a notebook from her pocket and starts scribbling away.
lines.3: For some reason, my name is already on that page.
lines.4: Underneath it, she writes, 'that damn insolent first-year girl.'
lines.7: 「Hey, my name was in there too!」
lines.8: So this girl has even harbored murderous thoughts about me.
lines.10: 「Well, killing them isn't really the point. I want to make them submit.」
lines.11: 「Otome was a good person, but that girl is pure evil.」
lines.12: 「One day I'll make her my minion and bully her nonstop!」
lines.14: 「Don't make up your own next-episode preview.」
lines.15: So we came up empty today...
lines.16: That last encounter drained me all at once.
